extracted.intended_audience: GAP users and computational group theorists working with character tables, power maps, and class fusions
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance and consistency checks for computing/validating power maps, element orders, class fusions, and parametrized maps for character tables in GAP. Describes the criteria each routine enforces and the expected properties/constraints on parametrized maps and fusion/power-map consistency.

rubrics_metrics.name: Congruences for characters under p-th power and Galois action
rubrics_metrics.description: For each character χ of G and each element g in G, the values χ(g^p) and GaloisCyc(χ(g), p) are algebraic integers that are congruent modulo p; if p does not divide the element order of g then the two values are equal. For linear characters λ among these characters, the condition χ(g)^p = χ(g^p) is checked.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This criterion is checked by the Congruences function (73.6.2). The set of characters to check is controlled by the chars option. It enforces congruence of p-th powers with Galois-cycling and exact equality when p is coprime to the element order; for linear characters the simpler equality χ(g)^p = χ(g^p) is used.

rubrics_metrics.name: Kernels closed under p-th power and index-dependent conditions
rubrics_metrics.description: For each character χ of G, the kernel is a normal subgroup N, and g^p ∈ N for all g ∈ N; moreover, if N has index p in G then g^p ∈ N for all g ∈ G, and if the index of N in G is coprime to p then g^p ∉ N for each g ∉ N.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This condition is checked for the kernels of characters specified by options using the ConsiderKernels function (73.6.3). It enforces normality and specific containment/exclusion conditions of p-th powers relative to kernel index arithmetic (index p vs index coprime to p).

rubrics_metrics.name: Use of smaller-power-maps when p exceeds element order
rubrics_metrics.description: If p is larger than the order m of an element g ∈ G then the class of g^p is determined by the power maps for primes dividing the residue of p modulo m. If these power maps are stored in the ComputedPowerMaps value of tbl then this information is used.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Checked in ConsiderSmallerPowerMaps (73.6.4). This lets the algorithm infer g^p from known power maps modulo m when p>m by decomposing p modulo m and using power maps for primes dividing that residue, provided those maps are present in ComputedPowerMaps.

rubrics_metrics.name: Symmetrization gives a character
rubrics_metrics.description: For each character χ of G, the symmetrization ψ defined by ψ(g) = (χ(g)^p − χ(g^p))/p is a character.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This condition is checked for the kernels of characters specified by options using PowerMapsAllowedBySymmetrizations (73.6.6). The option 'decompose' may be used to control whether symmetrizations must decompose into the available character list.

rubrics_metrics.name: Element orders uniquely determined by power maps
rubrics_metrics.description: If a powermap list contains p-th power maps, ElementOrdersPowerMap returns the order of elements in each class when that order is uniquely determined by powermap; otherwise returns an Unknown.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: ElementOrdersPowerMap returns a list whose i-th entry is the element order of class i if uniquely determined by powermap, otherwise an Unknown placeholder (see Chapter 74). Example usage demonstrates Unknown entries when some power maps are missing and how completing ComputedPowerMaps yields full OrdersClassRepresentatives agreement.

rubrics_metrics.name: PowerMapByComposition requires prime-power divisors present
rubrics_metrics.description: If the power maps for all prime divisors of n are stored in the ComputedPowerMaps list of tbl then PowerMapByComposition returns the n-th power map of tbl; otherwise fail is returned.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: PowerMapByComposition composes known prime-power maps to produce composite n-th maps. If any needed prime-divisor map is missing, the function fails (unless the explicit PowerMap(tbl,n) was computed/stored before).

rubrics_metrics.name: Permutation group action on possible power maps
rubrics_metrics.description: The permutation group of matrix automorphisms acts on the possible power maps by permuting the list via Permuted and then mapping the images via OnPoints; table automorphisms act trivially by definition.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: OrbitPowerMaps and RepresentativesPowerMaps provide orbit computations and orbit representatives under this group action. Use these to reduce redundant possible power maps to canonical representatives (see examples).

rubrics_metrics.name: Class fusion representation and ambiguity
rubrics_metrics.description: For a group G and subgroup H, a class fusion from H to G is a list giving for each class of H the position of its image class in G; when no underlying group data is available, class fusion is generally not unique and only necessary conditions can be checked yielding multiple possibilities.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Class fusions between Brauer tables derive from underlying ordinary tables. ComputedClassFusions stores important fusions (e.g., from maximal subgroups). PossibleClassFusions computes all maps satisfying necessary conditions, while FusionConjugacyClasses attempts to compute a unique fusion when groups/tables make this possible.

rubrics_metrics.name: PossibleClassFusions: centralizer and element-order condition
rubrics_metrics.description: For class i, the centralizer order of the image in G is a multiple of the i-th centralizer order in H, and the element orders in the i-th class and its image are equal.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This necessary condition is checked in InitFusion (73.7.1) and is fundamental to any candidate fusion: images must have compatible centralizer sizes and identical element orders.

rubrics_metrics.name: PossibleClassFusions: compatibility with power maps
rubrics_metrics.description: The class fusion must commute with power maps.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This is validated using TestConsistencyMaps (73.5.12), which repeatedly applies TransferDiagram checks involving subgroup and group power maps to prune inconsistent fusion candidates.

rubrics_metrics.name: PossibleClassFusions: permutation character consistency
rubrics_metrics.description: If a permutation character of G corresponding to the action on cosets of H is specified, it prescribes for each class C of G the number of elements of H fusing into C; only fusions affording that permutation character are computed.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The option permchar (a values list or permutation character) restricts fusions to those that realize the given permutation character; CheckPermChar (73.7.2) enforces this.

rubrics_metrics.name: PossibleClassFusions: use of table automorphisms to reduce orbits
rubrics_metrics.description: Table automorphisms of tbl are used to compute only orbit representatives; however, PossibleClassFusions returns the full orbits (not just reps).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: AutomorphismsOfTable is used to avoid redundant candidates by computing orbit representatives; but callers should be aware the full set (including orbit mates) is returned unless RepresentativesFusions is applied.

rubrics_metrics.name: PossibleClassFusions: restrictions of characters must be characters
rubrics_metrics.description: For each character χ of G, the restriction to H via the class fusion must be a character of H.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This condition is checked for characters specified via the chars option by FusionsAllowedByRestrictions (73.7.4). Options subchars and decompose control the set into which restrictions must decompose and whether decomposition is assumed/checked.

rubrics_metrics.name: PossibleClassFusions: class multiplication coefficients inequality
rubrics_metrics.description: The class multiplication coefficients (structure constants) in subtbl do not exceed the corresponding coefficients in tbl.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: ConsiderStructureConstants (73.3.7) enforces that for all triples (i,j,k), ClassMultiplicationCoefficient(subtbl,i,j,k) ≤ ClassMultiplicationCoefficient(tbl,σ[i],σ[j],σ[k]) for a candidate fusion σ. The verify option controls whether this (often expensive) check is performed; default is false except when multiple orbits exist.

rubrics_metrics.name: ComputedClassFusions storage record components
rubrics_metrics.description: Each stored class fusion entry is a record with components: name (identifier of destination table), map (list of image class positions), optional text (string with additional info), and optional specification to distinguish multiple fusions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When fetching/storing fusions via GetFusionMap and StoreFusion, be aware stored fusions may differ from returned maps due to ClassPermutation of destination tables; GetFusionMap/StoreFusion handle this adjustment automatically.

rubrics_metrics.name: GetFusionMap returns stored fusion or fail
rubrics_metrics.description: GetFusionMap checks ComputedClassFusions of source for a record whose name matches Identifier(destination) and returns its map component; if none found returns fail. For Brauer-table pairs it may derive/stash the ordinary-table fusion.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: An optional specification argument selects among multiple stored fusions distinguished by the specification component.

rubrics_metrics.name: StoreFusion uniqueness and specification requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: StoreFusion stores a fusion map (or record) from source to destination in ComputedClassFusions(source) and records the destination identifier on destination; if fusions to destination already exist on source then another fusion may be stored only if it has a specification component distinguishing it, otherwise an error is raised.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the specification field when multiple distinct fusions to the same destination must be stored; NamesOfFusionSources of the destination is updated automatically.

rubrics_metrics.name: ConsiderStructureConstants selection criterion
rubrics_metrics.description: From a list of candidate fusions, ConsiderStructureConstants returns those maps σ in fusions such that for all triples (i,j,k) the class multiplication coefficient in subtbl for (i,j,k) is ≤ the corresponding coefficient in tbl for (σ[i],σ[j],σ[k]).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The quick boolean argument limits checks to triples where at least two entries in fusions have different images. This routine implements the structure-constant inequality described in PossibleClassFusions point 6.

rubrics_metrics.name: Parametrized map entry constraints
rubrics_metrics.description: A parametrized map is a list whose i-th entry is either unbound, the image of the i-th class (an integer or cyclotomic for characters), or a list of possible images; strings and lists of strings may appear for class names, but character constants are not allowed.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Parametrized maps represent sets of concrete maps where map[i] equals paramap[i] or is contained in paramap[i] when paramap[i] is a list. They cannot represent images that themselves are lists (except strings). This definition governs all parametrized-map routines.

rubrics_metrics.name: Composition of parametrized maps
rubrics_metrics.description: CompositionMaps(paramap2, paramap1) is the parametrized map containing all compositions f2◦f1 with f1 in paramap1 and f2 in paramap2; concretely, if paramap1[class] is an integer then the composition at class is paramap2[paramap1[class]], otherwise it is the union of paramap2[i] for i in paramap1[class].
rubrics_metrics.guidance: CompositionMaps is used to compose class fusions and power maps, and to transfer information between subgroup and group tables; examples illustrate union and single-integer behavior.

rubrics_metrics.name: InverseMap semantics
rubrics_metrics.description: InverseMap(paramap) returns a parametrized map whose i-th entry is unbound if i is not in the image of paramap, equal to j if i is the image of paramap[j] for exactly one j, and equal to the set of all preimages of i under paramap otherwise.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: CompositionMaps(paramap, InverseMap(paramap)) yields the identity map. InverseMap is used to transfer power maps or fusions 'up' and 'down' between factor/group tables as shown in examples.

rubrics_metrics.name: ProjectionMap produces left-inverse parametrized map
rubrics_metrics.description: ProjectionMap(fusionmap) returns a parametrized map whose i-th entry is unbound if i is not in the image of fusionmap, and equal to the smallest j such that i is the image of fusionmap[j]. CompositionMaps(fusionmap, ProjectionMap(fusionmap)) is the identity.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: ProjectionMap collapses multiple preimages to a canonical representative (smallest j), useful for deriving a parametrized inverse that composes to identity on the image.

rubrics_metrics.name: Indirected: applying a character via parametrized map
rubrics_metrics.description: Indirected(character, paramap) returns a parametrized map whose entry at position i is character[paramap[i]] if paramap[i] is an integer, and an unknown otherwise.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used to compute possible restricted character values when fusion information is parametrized; entries that are not single integers become Unknown placeholders.

rubrics_metrics.name: Parametrized and ContainedMaps are inverses
rubrics_metrics.description: Parametrized(list) returns the smallest parametrized map containing all maps in list; ContainedMaps(paramap) returns the set of all concrete maps contained in paramap. Parametrized(ContainedMaps(paramap)) equals paramap.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: These two functions convert between explicit enumerations of maps and compact parametrized representations; examples show how Parametrized collapses multiple maps into lists of possible images.

rubrics_metrics.name: UpdateMap narrows parametrized map by character composition
rubrics_metrics.description: UpdateMap(character, paramap, indirected) changes paramap so it contains exactly the maps whose composition with character equals indirected; if a contradiction is detected it returns false, otherwise true.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used to refine parametrized fusion maps by enforcing that composing with a given character yields a specified indirected parametrized map or concrete values; examples show successful refinement of a previously wide InitFusion.

rubrics_metrics.name: MeetMaps intersect possible images
rubrics_metrics.description: MeetMaps(paramap1, paramap2) changes paramap1 so that the image at class i is the intersection of paramap1[i] and paramap2[i]; if any class becomes empty (no images remain), its position is returned, otherwise true.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: MeetMaps implements constraint intersection across parametrized maps and signals the first inconsistency position when no common image remains for a class.

rubrics_metrics.name: CommutativeDiagram consistency pruning
rubrics_metrics.description: CommutativeDiagram(paramap1,paramap2,paramap3,paramap4[,improvements]) checks consistency of the equality CompositionMaps(paramap2,paramap1) = CompositionMaps(paramap4,paramap3) and prunes parametrized maps by removing impossible images; returns fail on inconsistency, otherwise a record listing which entries were changed.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: An optional improvements record restricts diagrams considered to those having certain preimage sets. This routine is used to enforce commutative relations among composed parametrized maps and to tighten parametrizations.

rubrics_metrics.name: CheckFixedPoints enforces fixed-point mapping
rubrics_metrics.description: CheckFixedPoints(inside1, between, inside2) assumes 'between' maps each fixed point of inside1 to a fixed point of inside2 (i.e., inside1[i]=i => between[i] is fixed by inside2 or list intersects images under inside2). It removes entries violating this and returns fail on inconsistency or a list of changed positions otherwise.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This enforces consistency of fixed-point behavior across parametrized maps — e.g., that fusion/power maps respect fixed classes — and is used when transferring power-map constraints between subgroup and group.

rubrics_metrics.name: TransferDiagram: specialized commutative check with duplicated middle map
rubrics_metrics.description: TransferDiagram(inside1, between, inside2[,improvements]) checks diagrams where the 'between' map occurs twice and ensures CompositionMaps(m2,f) = CompositionMaps(f,m1) consistency, pruning impossible images; returns fail on inconsistency, otherwise a record of positions changed.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TransferDiagram is similar to CommutativeDiagram but tailored to the common situation where the same intermediate parametrized map appears on both sides of a commutative relation; improvements record can restrict preimages considered.

rubrics_metrics.name: TestConsistencyMaps repeatedly applies transfer-diagram checks
rubrics_metrics.description: TestConsistencyMaps(powermap1, fusionmap, powermap2[,fusimp]) repeatedly applies TransferDiagram for each i (matching entries in powermap lists and fusionmap) until no more changes occur; returns false if an inconsistency is detected, otherwise true.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Typical usage: fusionmap is an approximate class fusion and powermap1/powermap2 are lists of power maps for subgroup and group, respectively; optional fusimp restricts preimages considered. This is the core consistency check invoked by PossibleClassFusions to enforce power-map commutation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Indeterminateness of a parametrized map
rubrics_metrics.description: Indeterminateness(paramap) returns the number of maps contained in paramap, i.e., the product of the lengths of lists in paramap that denote several images.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This quantifies ambiguity: a paramap with many list-entries has large indeterminateness. Used to decide branching thresholds and control heuristics (parameters maxamb, minamb, maxlen) when choosing characters to branch on.
